heading_path: 20.14A  Requirement to notify of serious offence
text: (1) A registered trade marks attorney who has been charged with a serious offence must, within 14 days after being charged, notify the Designated Manager, in writing, of the charge. (2) If the registered trade marks attorney: (a) fails to comply with subregulation (1); and (b) does not have a reasonable excuse for failing to comply; the failure to comply constitutes unsatisfactory professional conduct.
title: Requirement to notify of serious offence

units.text: (1) A registered trade marks attorney who has been charged with a serious offence must, within 14 days after being charged, notify the Designated Manager, in writing, of the charge.
(2) If the registered trade marks attorney:
(a) fails to comply with subregulation (1); and
(b) does not have a reasonable excuse for failing to comply;
the failure to comply constitutes unsatisfactory professional conduct.
